newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - July 24.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
- Memorial Hall of the Beiping-Tianjin Campaign of the Liberation War formally inaugurated in Tianjin
- China publishes first encyclopedia on military sciences, an 11-volume landmark coinciding with 70th anniversary of the founding of People's Liberation Army on August 1.
- Ancient city of Xi'an becomes more attractive by its historical relices as well as modernised buildings, new squares, rebuilt avenues, more trees and green belts.

- With establishment of new management and operation system of state-owned assets in Wuhan, net asset value of state-owned assets companies increases from one billion yuan to 1.5 billion yuan in two years.
- Agricultural Bank of China issues 1.0 billion yuan in mortgage loans
- PICC Property Zhejiang pays 47.544 million yuan insurance to 200 firms hit by recent floods
- Post-tax profits of 75 major steel enterprises reached 900 million yuan
- Sinopec crude oil processing reached 61 million tonnes in the first half, up a year-on-year 4.3 percent
- From January to May, profits of profit-making state firms rose 14.93 percent and losses of loss-making state firms dropped 47.26 percentage points from a year-ago
- Revenue from personal income taxes continued to increase rapidly in the first half.
- Customs collected 44.72 billion yuan of taxes in the first half, up 3.84 percent from the same period last year
- China joins Unidroit Convention on Stolen or Illegal Exported Cultural Objects, which aims to prevent illegal trading and smuggling of cultural relics
